# aj project

Work with projects.


## `aj project list`

List the projects you can see.

```text
aj project list [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-q`, `--query` `TEXT` |  | Only projects whose key or name match. |
| `--recent` |  | Up to 20 projects you viewed recently. |
| `--archived` |  | Only archived projects. |
| `--trashed` |  | Only projects in the trash. |
| `-l`, `--limit` `INTEGER` | `50` | Show at most this many results. |
| `-A`, `--all` |  | Fetch every page, ignoring --limit. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |


## `aj project view`

Show a project's details, issue types and components.

```text
aj project view KEY [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KEY` | required | Project key, e.g. DEMO. |
| `-w`, `--web` |  | Open it in the browser instead. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `aj project create`

Create a company-managed project.

```text
aj project create [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
aj project create -k OPS -n "Operations" -T kanban
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-k`, `--key` `TEXT` |  | New project key, e.g. DEMO. |
| `--name` `TEXT` |  | Project name. |
| `-T`, `--template` `TEXT` |  | scrum, kanban, basic, tasks, process, service, or a full Jira template key. Default: kanban. |
| `--lead` `TEXT` |  | Project lead (default: you). |
| `-d`, `--description` `TEXT` |  | Description. |
| `--url` `TEXT` |  | A web address for the project. |
| `--from-json` `PATH` |  | Read the details from a JSON file. |
| `--print-template` |  | Print an example --from-json file. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `aj project update`

Change a project's key, name, lead, description or URL.

```text
aj project update PROJECT [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PROJECT` | required | Project key, e.g. DEMO. |
| `-k`, `--key` `TEXT` |  | New key. |
| `--name` `TEXT` |  | New name. |
| `--lead` `TEXT` |  | New lead. |
| `-d`, `--description` `TEXT` |  | New description. |
| `--url` `TEXT` |  | New URL. |
| `--from-json` `PATH` |  | Read the changes from a JSON file. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `aj project delete`

Move a project to the trash (restorable for 60 days), or delete it for good.

```text
aj project delete KEY [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KEY` | required | Project key, e.g. DEMO. |
| `--permanent` |  | Skip the trash: cannot be undone. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `aj project archive`

Archive a project (read-only, restorable).

```text
aj project archive KEY [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KEY` | required | Project key, e.g. DEMO. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `aj project restore`

Restore a project from the trash or the archive.

```text

```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KEY` | required | Project key, e.g. DEMO. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
